currentIdentityRule: One logical ID and one native Google Doc ID per maintained document. Revision numbers change; the current URL does not.
transaction: Resolve the current document by logical ID; read all relevant tabs and current provider revision.
Copy the complete current native Doc to the verified archive folder, named with its EXISTING revision ID.
Read the archive back and verify content plus a separate provider ID before changing current.
Edit the SAME current Google Doc using requiredRevisionId. Increment the logical revision by exactly one.
Verify content and canonical provider ID; record before/after hashes, archive receipt, date and change reason.
firstCreation: Only when no document exists for that logical ID; register R000001 once. Never create a replacement current Doc for later revisions.
onFailure: Stop the mutation on an archive/readback failure or concurrent edit. Keep current intact; reconcile before retrying. An archive is not the new current.
contentPlacement: Project engineering working calculations, audits and alternatives belong in the canonical private Google Doc. Public Pages contains verified source references, reusable code rules and selected model geometry; no parallel public draft/audit editions.
automationBoundary: Actions validates the code register and transaction/receipt contract. It has no Drive credential and does not itself copy or update Google Docs. An authorized Drive connector or authenticated owner worker performs native operations.
privacy: Private provider IDs, URLs and engineering working notes stay outside the public repository. Public records use logical IDs and content hashes only.

currentDocuments.purpose: Ashok engineering, code applicability, services and decision record
currentDocuments.locator: Resolve by logical ID in the project's Documentation folder
currentDocuments.revisionAuthority: Read the current revision and archive links from the native Google Doc; do not mirror a stale private revision counter publicly.
